{{Top|leg}}
'''Kolazhi''' was one of the main components of [[Kolcta]]. It was the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] [[Seeqov Thranx]] who learned how to splice the DNA into the [[Alazhi/Legends|alazhi]] plant. Numerous kolazhi fields grew on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] took over the planet. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as the [[Bloodletter]] supervised the harvesting of one field, making off with several tons of kolcta while the rest of the fields suffered a mysterious blight.<ref name="bacta">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031106thyferra|text=Thyferra: Bacta Basics|int=Thyferra: Bacta Basics}}</ref>

A few hidden fields survived eradication on the planet, and new kolcta was produced in small lots up to the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
